notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
You have no other Whales on the battlefield or in your graveyard.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
The token Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
The nontoken Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing the Great Whale token, returning the nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
